objectives:
(Course taught in English)
The purpose of this course is to equip students with the skills to conduct academic research, as well as the ability to publish papers using contemporary research methodologies, if possible. First, in each class, we will have a briefing on the individual steps of the research process, which is to help participating students build the background knowledge of research methodologies. Further, in order to equip students with the capability of practically applying the learned methodological skills, students are requested to collect and present scholarly articles in the methodological section. These presented articles should cover those frequently applied methods, such as survey research, laboratory experiment, scenario-based experiment, field experiment, longitudinal study, content analysis, big-data/behavioral-data analysis, business analytics, mixed-methods research, and neuroscience (EEG, eye tracking, fMRI) from top-tier journals in your own field.
